testcase.name: Scenario: Open and dismisses a grouped command menu: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:377:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open and dismisses a grouped command menu ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the 3D Model Work Features panel contains a grouped "Plane" command ✔ When the user clicks the Plane drop-down arrow ✔ Then a vertical menu opens beneath the control ✔ And the menu contains "Plane", "Offset from Plane", and "Three Points" ✔ And the menu presents icons and dividers between groups of choices ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the menu closes ✔ And the part remains visible without a plane command being started
